about: Uptime Kuma 2.x Gotify provider (server/notification-providers/gotify.js): strips one trailing slash from the server URL, then axios.post(`${url}/message?token=${token}`, { message, priority: gotifyPriority || 8, title: "Uptime-Kuma" }). Down and Up both arrive at the configured priority with the fixed title, so Gotify gives no resolved signal.
provenance: Rebuilt from the sender's source code and docs on 2026-11-04, not captured from a live sender. Replace with a capture when one exists (integrations/alert-intake/README.md, Capturing fixtures).
